groups.name: spring.python.jep
groups.description: Configuration properties for the JEP-based Python executor integration.

properties.name: spring.python.jep.enabled
properties.description: Whether the JEP (Java Embedded Python) executor autoconfiguration is enabled.

properties.name: spring.python.jep.interpreter-type
properties.description: The type of JEP interpreter to use.

properties.name: spring.python.jep.python-library-path
properties.description: The absolute path to the Python library ('.../libpythonXY.so' or '.../pythonXY.dll' or etc).
